title: Matthew Henson on the North Pole expedition
summary: Henson accompanied Robert Peary on seven Arctic voyages over 23 years, including the 1908-09 expedition that claimed to reach the North Pole.
why: A key member of one of the famous polar expeditions.

unsung.contribution: Served as a key member of Peary's Arctic expeditions, including the 1909 North Pole attempt.
unsung.recognition: Peary received many honours while Henson's contributions were largely ignored; he was re-interred at Arlington only in 1988.
